rationale: Five long-history shifted diagnostics fail after averaging both registered fits, but same-fit native counterparts are unavailable. Admit six frozen native second-fit references: artifact, sparse and complete evidence with 64 and 256 past episodes, all at 32768 labels. The 256-episode references complete native-versus-shift comparisons for the present and next complete-record blocks. The 64-episode references enable the matched native history-length comparison at the same label budget and fit allocation, testing whether the large losses are associated with retained history rather than the rule change. These are distinct predeclared contrasts, with no extra worlds, settings or seeds outside the forest. Restore a measured day of useful work while preserving confirmation priority and its reserve.
